name: Vedic Astrology (Jyotish)
policy: 80/20 verified practical core; source/local CLI, not exhaustive tradition coverage

supported.D1: Nine grahas, sidereal Ascendant, twelve rashis, whole-sign houses, explicit apparent coordinates and mean nodes; astronomical epochs 1850–2149, abs(latitude)<66.
supported.ayanamsha: Revised true Lahiri 1956 anchor + pinned Skyfield Capitaine2003/IAU2000A realization, named lahiri-1956-skyfield; no hidden correction to Swiss model.
supported.nakshatra: 27 equal mansions, four padas, Moon starting lord and boundary sensitivity; names from PVR Table2.
supported.conditions: Classical sign lords, ownership/exaltation/debilitation, unambiguous moolatrikona intervals and full whole-sign graha aspects. No strength score.
supported.Vimshottari: Moon birthstar Mahadasha/Antardasha, full-parent initial AD sequence, birth balance, current/upcoming periods; fixed elapsed savana360 or explicit solar365.2425 years, half-open timestamps, target ages 0–120 selected years.
supported.D9: Modality-based Navamsa mapping, symbolic longitudes and Lagna, separate D9 whole-sign house frame and sign dignities; literal same-sign D1/D9 flags, not an inferred strength total.
supported.interpretation: Source-labeled dignity/aspect and active-lord conditions, selected D9 methodology; compositional only, no direct personal-event or compatibility reading.
supported.interfaces: jyotish JSON/Markdown; optional --d9, --target, --year-key. Existing Western interfaces retained.

experimental: Comparisons to rounded published charts where exact original ephemeris/time realization is not specified; precision/contradictions disclosed.

verification.independent: Six Swiss/Moshier position/node/ASC charts at common explicit TT/UT1 inputs; time-model independence is not claimed. D9 harmonic-reference calculation differs from production modality algorithm.
verification.symbolic: Independent rational Vimshottari implementation with Swiss Moon inputs; same documented symbolic rule, not an independent prediction method.
verification.published: PVR Chart1 planets and Lagna sign; Chart54 complete birth inputs, D1 positions and D9 signs; D9 Example16; Vimshottari Example50 exact fraction/balance and Venus AD duration table.
verification.source_limits: Chart1 exact ASC differs ~8.9 arcminutes from both engines; source civil July15 date in Example50 conflicts with stated fixed elapsed savana arithmetic (July16). No reproduction of those exact discrepant values claimed. Raman worked-page access not verified.
verification.precision: Position tolerance .01 degree, ASC .02 degree, ayanamsha1 arcsecond; dasha Moon agreement .0005 degree with derived time-sensitivity bound, not an arbitrary probability/confidence score. Published rounding and birth-time uncertainty remain material.
verification.full_regression: 73 passing tests, including all prior 63 Western tests

licensing: Existing pinned Skyfield/JPL local/source policy retained; no dependency added and no Swiss runtime or book text/images distributed. Procedural numeric facts and short original source-located summaries only.

P1: Direct source-backed interpretations for the core
Jaimini seven/eight karaka and Chara-dasha profiles when source-verified
Selected additional vargas by use case
Resolve published/source discrepancies when reliable evidence becomes available
P2: KP and Prashna as distinct schools
True nodes/additional ayanamshas with independent tests

next: Commit closure before beginning Technique #3 resource/variation audit; retain bounded named profile and P1/P2 refinement.
